data.title: Nida Poll: Opposition leader and his party most popular
data.description: An opinion survey found most respondents liked the opposition-core People's Party (PP) and its leader over Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and his Bhumjaithai Party (BJT).

data.title: Thousands stranded, Lat Krabang evacuates flooded residents
data.description: Rescuers rushed to evacuate bedridden patients, elderly residents and other vulnerable people from a flood-stricken housing estate in Bangkok's Lat Krabang district on Sunday, with floodwaters neck-high in some places.

data.title: AGT winner Nene Royal arrives back in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - America's Got Talent 2026 winner Nene Royal arrived back home on this southern tourist island on Sunday morning to a warm welcome and a planned evening parade.

data.title: Schoolboy hailed for clearing rubbish from flooded city street
data.description: Amid heavy flooding in Bangkok, a schoolboy's simple act of civic-mindedness has drawn widespread praise online after he was filmed wading through murky water to collect floating rubbish before it could clog the drains.

data.title: Heavy flooding continues in eastern Bangkok
data.description: Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt said heavy flooding continued in eastern districts of Bangkok, where most main canals remained full on Sunday.

data.title: More rain in Central Plains, will ease off in Bangkok
data.description: It will rain heavily in the western part of the Central Plains while rain will continue and then start to decline in Greater Bangkok and the East on Sunday, according to the Meteorological Department.

data.title: Heavy flooding remains in eastern Bangkok

data.title: Heavy rain continues in Central Plains: weathermen
data.description: It will rain heavily in the western part of the Central Plains while rain will continue and start to decline in Greater Bangkok and the East on Sunday, according to the Meteorological Department.

data.title: Seaplane project studied
data.description: SATUN: Transport Ministry is assessing the feasibility of seaplane operations on Koh Lipe, focusing on safety and environmental impacts.

data.title: Unlicensed hotels closed
data.description: PHUKET: Five hotels in the province have been ordered to suspend operations temporarily after authorities found that they failed to obtain licences and meet improvement requirements.

data.title: Govt defends solar sector as China supplies 99.3% of imports
data.description: The government has defended the domestic solar industry after figures showed China supplied 99.3% of solar-panel imports in the first seven months of 2026.

data.title: CP firm to run Airport Rail Link until January under same rules
data.description: The State Railway of Thailand and Asia Era One, a CP Group company, have agreed that the private firm will keep running the Airport Rail Link for four more months.

data.title: Klatham keeps options open
data.description: The Klatham Party has caused a stir by going against the opposition whip's position and voting in support of the 2027 budget bill.

data.title: 10,000 troops sent to flood-hit provinces
data.description: More than 10,000 troops and 1,000 vehicles have been deployed nationwide to help people hit by heavy rain and flooding.

data.title: City storms likely to ease this week
data.description: Rainfall in Bangkok and parts of central and eastern Thailand is expected to ease from Monday, although flood-prone areas remain under watch.

data.title: Ekniti defends co-pay extension
data.description: The extension of the Thais Help Thais Plus co-payment scheme is a response to the ongoing energy crisis, not a populist policy, Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas said.

data.title: THAI offers flood-affected ticket holders free date change
data.description: Thai Airways International says it will allow one travel date change until Tuesday for passengers affected by flooding in Bangkok and surrounding areas.

data.title: Social Security Board election postponed due to flooding
data.description: The nationwide election for a new Social Security Board has been rescheduled from Sunday to Oct 11 due to heavy rain and flooding in several parts of the country, organisers said on Saturday.

data.title: Red Line railway services suspended
data.description: Services on the suburban Red Line commuter railway were temporarily suspended on Saturday evening after an electrical system failure affected its signalling system.

data.title: Social Security Board election postponement urged
data.description: The People’s Party and a veteran labour leader have called for the Social Security Board election scheduled for Sunday to be postponed because of severe flooding in several parts of the country.

data.title: Agencies team up to provide flood travel updates
data.description: With floods causing transport chaos across Bangkok, authorities are stepping up measures to assist travellers and tourists facing delays in getting to airports and, in some cases, missed flights.

data.title: Free parking at train stations, malls in flooded Bangkok
data.description: Many buildings around Bangkok and surrounding areas are offering free parking for people affected by flooding, including park-and-ride facilities at train stations and garages at shopping malls.

data.title: All 50 Bangkok districts declared disaster areas
data.description: All 50 districts of Bangkok have been declared disaster zones as heavy rain continues to cause flooding, traffic problems and disruptions to daily life.

data.title: Democrats face identity test
data.description: The Democrat Party's decision to take a harder line on the Senate election-fraud case is exposing a potentially costly fault line between its stated commitment to democratic institutions and the political identity of part of its traditional support base.

data.title: Snooker prospects 'at risk'
data.description: Thailand celebrates its snooker champions, but players and lawmakers say gambling regulations are making it harder to train the next generation.

data.title: Amlo to take victims' claims
data.description: The Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) is preparing to accept claims from victims of alleged investment fraud involving Yim Leak, Benjamin Mauerberger, also known as Ben Smith, and their associates. Assets seized or frozen in the case are now valued at more than 26.337 billion baht.

data.title: BMTA sees EV fleet as ticket to ending losses
data.description: The Bangkok Mass Transit Authority (BMTA) expects to end its operating losses by 2030 as an electric vehicle (EV) fleet cuts costs and raises efficiency.

data.title: Eastern Bangkok under water
data.description: Eastern Bangkok is heavily flooded. All local canals are full and 15 main roads are deep underwater on Sunday morning, according to Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt.

data.title: Vegetarian Festival in Phuket to net 1.4 billion baht
data.description: Phuket expects this year's Vegetarian Festival to generate at least 1.4 billion baht in economic activity as more than 140,000 visitors are forecast to attend.

data.title: Festival to net B1.4bn
data.description: Phuket expects this year's Vegetarian Festival to generate at least 1.4 billion baht in economic activity as more than 140,000 visitors are forecast to attend.

data.title: New app 'eases' Thai immigration
data.description: Foreign visitors to Thailand will have easier access to immigration and travel services through the newly launched Thai Immigration (THIM) Application, Pol Lt Gen Panumas Boonyalug, Immigration Bureau commissioner, said.

data.title: Spanish chef loses appeal against life sentence
data.description: The Appeal Court has upheld a life sentence for Spanish chef Daniel Sancho Bronchalo for the premeditated murder of Colombian surgeon Edwin Arrieta Arteaga on Koh Phangan.

data.title: Court to rule on ballot barcodes
data.description: Attention is turning to Monday's Constitutional Court ruling on barcodes and QR codes on election ballots, with a former election commissioner outlining four possible outcomes, ranging from no change to a fresh general election.

data.title: Cancer plans face funding shortfall
data.description: HONG KONG: Funding for national cancer control plans remains critically insufficient, with fewer than 10% fully funded worldwide, the president of the Union for International Cancer Control (UICC) has warned.

data.title: Court upholds ruling disqualifying NBTC chairman
data.description: The Central Administrative Court upheld a ruling disqualifying National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) chairman Dr Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck from office, finding that his work at a state-run hospital breached eligibility rules.

data.title: Court acquits iCon founder ‘Boss Paul’ in money-laundering case
data.description: The Criminal Court acquitted The iCon Group founder and CEO Warathaphon “Boss Paul” Waratyaworrakul, politician Samart Janechaijittawanich and his mother, Wilawan Phutthasamrit, of charges of colluding to launder 2.5 million baht from the direct-sales company.
